notes.title: New Update Now Live: Patch Notes, plus Mobile News!
notes.content:
[p]Hey Campers![/p][p][/p][p]Today we’re adding a small patch to Pine Hearts on Steam, as well as Nintendo Switch, which introduces some of your most wanted features, including secondary quest tracking, collectibles tracking and touchscreen support, as well as some performance optimisations. [/p][p][/p][p]Here’s a breakdown of what to expect:[/p][p][b]New Features [/b][/p][p]● New Secondary Quest Tracker - You can now keep track of all side-quests in Tyke’s journal.[/p][p]● New Droplet Tracker - You can now keep track of all the Droplets you have collected and how many you can find in each region of the game. [/p][p]● New Supported Languages - You can now play Pine Hearts in Korean, Japanese, and Traditional Chinese. [/p][p]● Touch Screen Support - You can now use your device’s touch screen to play Pine Hearts. 
[/p][p][b]QOL Features[/b][/p][p]● Tyke’s local region map is now on its own page of the journal, and has been enlarged and made clearer. [/p][p]● Improved performance across all platforms.[/p][p]● Cutscenes now have their own audio controls and should perform better across devices.
[/p][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][p]● Fixed issues with the “Skip UI Animations” option.[/p][p]● Fixed issues with swapping input devices.[/p][p]● Fixed issues with Tyke being able to move during certain interactions. [/p][p]● Fixed bugs caused by closing and reopening the game. [/p][p]● Fixed minor interaction, audio and UI bugs.[/p][p]● Fixed issues with UI scaling across different aspect ratios and removed in-game letterboxing. 

[b]Please note:[/b] This patch has been applied to both Steam and Switch versions but the patch numbers are different, so please make sure you’re playing on the correct version.
Steam: v1.3.0.246
Switch: v1.2.0.202[/p][p][/p][p][b]Mobile Launch Plans, Plus a New Look![/b][/p][p]We’re also excited to announce that Pine Hearts is coming to iOS and Android devices on September 23rd, so you can take Tyke with you wherever you wander. You can pre-order now on the [url="https://apps.apple.com/us/app/pine-hearts/id6745611937"][u]App Store[/u][/url] and [url="https://apps.apple.com/us/app/pine-hearts/id6745611937"][u]Google Play Store[/u][/url].

Also, did you see our beautiful new keyart?
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41438465/42fee5c36647b8152842a3efd5926ae1881eabf5.png"][/img][/p][p]As always, if you’d like to chat more about Pine Hearts, you can join us over on[url="https://discord.com/invite/TYXxVxbvCC"] [u]Discord,[/u][/url] and if you’d like to follow Tyke’s Adventures, he now has a blog on[url="https://www.tumblr.com/pine-hearts"] [u]Tumblr[/u][/url]. We’d love to see you there.[/p][p]Chat soon![/p][p]Melissa and Vicki[/p][p]Pine Hearts Community Team[/p][p]

notes.title: 13 Wholesome Hidden Moments in Pine Hearts
notes.content:
[p][/p][p]Hey Campers!

Open up your adventure journal and prepare to take notes so that you don’t miss these wholesome hidden moments that lie just off the beaten path in Pine Hearts. [/p][p]They're not signposted, nor are they part of your main quest, but these wholesome moments will bring you joy as you play, enhance your experience, and may even reward you for engaging with those seemingly innocuous objects.[/p][p]
From finding treasure maps to wildlife encounters, we’re here to make sure you don’t miss them. [/p][p][b][u]Campsite[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p]If you’re a fan of skipping stones, you’ll find the perfect pile of rocks close to the Lone Campers HQ just waiting to be skipped across the water.[/p][/*][*][p]Keep a look out for a very good boy waiting patiently for some pets if you’re on your way to the Ruined Castle. Just don’t let Bonnie see.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXer-jaR_Mgo-pEyuCjAJrATBOzW5wR3WqsVYFGV4g-Hhbs7_nUMbpr78yM6Si5Xr3v52uH_AvZlLvuiQuTnSidLP1b8-e3D6vYp_hjdpuDGYhT-7bUEAIqNGkVPo-x0zPoy_j3s?key=Ddn1FFqb_NnGtZopbVEedJ96"][/img][/p][p][b][u]Ruined Castle[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p]The Castle Wall has a number of cannons placed along it which can all be interacted with. You may even find something useful inside one of them.[/p][/*][*][p]Find a penny, pick it up, for the rest of the day you’ll have good luck. Especially if you throw it into the wishing well near the Ruined Castle.[/p][/*][*][p]Watching the butterflies flit about among the gravestones is wholesome in itself, but once you have the right tools and abilities, you may find there’s more to them once you come back…
[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcTFxT5hwxweFdg_Ez6bsjRt6J5NU3M6L1NPRIU5tlH0QhX4JbGaJl_ohElaxw9q4_e7sAt122Gc5sMqikIDB_nydjF-fSdqdysZd2vOuHYkjQXe-cjJ9kTh4qCKjh9LAUI1pjwVQ?key=Ddn1FFqb_NnGtZopbVEedJ96"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p][b][u]Caravan Park[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p]Fancy a kick-about? Try your best to score a goal at the pitch close to the Play Park. [/p][/*][*][p]There’s nothing more Scottish than The Highland Games. You can attempt to beat the current champion just a log’s toss from the Gala.[/p][/*][*][p]Just a hop, skip and a jump away from the Pitchside Lets, you’ll find a fun and nostalgic way to indulge your inner child.
[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXc2caxK_qtXKGpzxjqTDUkpPRpT0PGZYJW1CF8X-QvEG1iVqhRxcawMrj4TZuQGnCfP3XoiVLCnwzsGMi6ZW4keVyTTgje1NxEjKLIZwNrEoAHq-PD3Kxv8GjIT3iPTpx8DFibHVg?key=Ddn1FFqb_NnGtZopbVEedJ96"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p][b][u]Golf Course[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p]If there’s one thing we highly recommend, it’s searching around the Golf Course for the Otter’s Den. If you take the time to find it beyond the blossom trees, you’ll be in for a treat.

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeGnUIT9EJqJvRhR67K9JxWnsUK7Ert8LoHWbF5V5UigWYyUWeESLwQvwTJjVWh-3FHa4Tes2TQvKrrNx3Iuw06Wdw_yVXQuVI6UK7ko7Qv8GPHA8QQs_CnCZs6r7VaLEBph_ieNQ?key=Ddn1FFqb_NnGtZopbVEedJ96"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p][b][u]Rockpools[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p]The Rockpools offer a diverse habitat for wildlife. If you’re lucky, you may encounter the elusive King Crab, as well as a family of seals, both of which offer wholesome and entertaining interactions.[/p][/*][*][p]There’s nothing more fun than scaring seagulls, which you’ll be able to do by pressing some big red buttons near the lighthouse.[/p][/*][*][p]Once you have earned the fishing rod, you’ll be able to fish at any of the many fishing spots around Pine Hearts. You might find some interesting things while fishing, and if not, it’s a pleasant way to pass some time.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve left a special piece of treasure lying around somewhere near the Rockpools, we just can’t quite remember where. Keep your eyes peeled for a message in a bottle which we're sure will offer a clue as to where to find it.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfxjOk36JKBNnKBQQtfUZ4Rp9xHPIXcVcJRKHOtePTk_kuSNKgEHJwsoTo0h4IqhRQSWUz_sXMACFigkoGQamdwEkg0Pz2J1jJCQVYEkYFdg8zEpBpsIJwdtWdLe-5DMb9pH5Hz?key=Ddn1FFqb_NnGtZopbVEedJ96"][/img][/p][p]If you’ve found any more wholesome moments we may not have included in the list (there are a lot!), please share them in the comments so that others can find and enjoy them.[/p][p]
Stay tuned, as we’ll soon be exploring some easily missed side quests, but for now, if you’re ready to begin your adventure, [b]Pine Hearts is 25% off in the Steam Summer Sale until July 10[/b].

If you’d like to chat more about Pine Hearts, you can join us over on [url="https://discord.com/invite/TYXxVxbvCC"]Discord[/url], and if you’d like to follow Tyke’s Adventures, drop by his blog on [url="https://www.tumblr.com/pine-hearts"]Tumblr[/url]. We’d love to see you there.

Chat soon!

Melissa and Vicki
Pine Hearts Community Team[/p]

notes.title: Reflection Road: Pine Hearts Team Share Father’s Day Tales
notes.content:
[h3]Hey Campers!  [/h3][h3][/h3][h3]This Sunday is Father’s Day here in the UK, and while not everyone will observe this occasion, with Pine Hearts having a heavy focus on Tyke’s childhood memories of his dad, we thought today would be the perfect time to dedicate a whole blog post to the devs and their dads.  [/h3][p][/p][h3]You may not know this about Pine Hearts, but it was created after the creative director at Hyper Luminal Games, Rob, lost his dad to cancer. Not only did Pine Hearts provide him with a way to channel his grief, but it was a great way to honour his dad and the times they shared together visiting the Cairngorms National Park up in sunny old Scotland.  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41438465/73d92648e11ec6a48d3260ecf2874d9711929786.gif"][/img]
[/h3][p][b]Melissa Cocker (Social Media and Community Coordinator @ HLG)[/b] [/p][p]“My Dad and I have always bonded over our love for music. He took me to my first gig when I was 11 to see My Chemical Romance, and he’s continued to completely inspire my taste in music as I’ve grown up. We’ve continued to be gig buddies, having the privilege to see many of our favourite bands together over the years. He’s also the person who got me interested in sci-fi and fantasy, so he’s played a big role in shaping the interests and passions that make me who I am.”[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41438465/45dc5e46214fc5f3f97bf881b6d89bfd49f10934.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]James Law (Art Manager @ HLG)[/b]   [/p][p]“My Dad taught me a billion things: he built us a proper action-figure sized concrete castle outside in our wee garden and filled around it with sand, he would hide surprise presents at the end of a treasure hunt, he always protected us seeing the fallout from what must have been tough experiences as a paramedic, he always supported my artistic pursuits and when he taught me how to paint he gave me this advice: 'never judge it until it's finished.' So now when I'm halfway through anything and can see the wobbles and doubt the outcome, I hold steady until it's at least complete. Then you can do better next time, or you surprise yourself with how it turned around. His dad also died before I was born, so he never had the luxury, as I do, of being a dad and going to his own father for advice.”[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Mihai Georgescu (Principal QA @ HLG)[/b] [/p][p]"I can't say I've had an idyllic relationship with my dad, but I still cherish the short times we spent together. Several years ago, we went on a family road trip across Romania. There were a few more disagreements on the way than any of us would have liked, but wherever we ended up staying for the night, dad and I would stay up and share a drink in silence, taking in the atmosphere of the summer air. In hindsight, I wish either of us had been brave enough to speak, but I'm still grateful for those few quiet moments together."[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41438465/feb75401f125c04ef83aaa14c3281519a6c23cde.jpg"][/img][/p][p]
[b]Vicki Fieldhouse (Senior Community Manager @ Secret Mode)[/b][/p][p]"My dad was the best. I have so many great memories from my childhood, from the piggy back rides to helping him build things in the back garden, but the memory that really sticks out is him reading The Hobbit to me and my brother. He'd do all the voices, sing all the songs and really brought the characters to life. Even to this day, it's one of my favourite books, but only because of the way he read it. He's also the reason I got interested in games. He introduced me to games really early on and never saw them as a waste of time, but something that could be enjoyed together, either with him or with my brother, and I'm so grateful for that." [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41438465/bc730684463a74e92500e551457e08bb91bcc544.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]We'd love to hear about your favourite memories of your dads, feel free to share them in the comments.[/b]
[/p][p]As always, if you’d like to chat more about Pine Hearts, you can join us over on[url="https://discord.com/invite/TYXxVxbvCC"] [u]Discord,[/u][/url] and if you’d like to follow Tyke’s Adventures, he now has a blog on[url="https://www.tumblr.com/pine-hearts"] [u]Tumblr[/u][/url]. We’d love to see you there.
[/p][p]Chat soon![/p][p]Melissa and Vicki[/p][p]Pine Hearts Community Team [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41438465/7422b829902cc37dd9d453df241eb7ad39201246.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Pine Hearts Features in Access-Ability Summer Showcase 2025!
notes.content:
[p]Hey Campers! [/p][p][/p][p]The[url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45010171/view/530973313390870957"] [/url][url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/Access-AbilitySummerShowcase2025"]Access-Ability Summer Showcase[/url] returns for its third year, with a Steam event highlighting games that have gone the extra mile to include accessible settings and design choices. Making Pine Hearts as accessible as possible is really important to us here at Hyper Luminal Games and Secret Mode, and we’re super proud that Pine Hearts has been selected to take part in this year’s showcase.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41438465/395ebecd7d04b8b0732fddc3163f4e36afc413c2.png"][/img][/p][p][b]You can watch the Access-Ability Summer Showcase on [/b][url="https://youtu.be/0tbuFnsaR50?si=F_wRhdRkFj81PMoQ"]YouTube[/url][b] on Friday 6th June 2025 at 4pm BST, 11am ET, 8am PT.[/b]

[b][u]How did we make Pine Hearts accessible?[/u][/b][/p][p]You can access the Accessibility menu as soon as you load Pine Hearts - and you’ll see it’s broken down into three sections: Gameplay, UI Support, and Visual Support.[/p][p][/p][p][u][b]Gameplay[/b][/u][/p][p]Run Mode allows you to adjust the default movement speed for Tyke, giving you the choice between a run or a slower walking pace, while Simplified Controls reduces the timed and held button presses for actions, replacing them with easy single-button presses.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41438465/6fdde0d5f3f140657dff7f58433c76ecfbf46b6d.gif"][/img][/p][p][u][b]UI Support[/b][/u][/p][p]Here you’ll be able to adjust text size and spacing, switching to a dyslexic-friendly font, as well as having the option to turn off UI animations.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41438465/903a0e2d0a359e5f9a7eecda89eda45aae5089cb.gif"][/img][/p][p][u][b]Visual Support[/b][/u][/p][p]Here you can adjust the contrast, turn off screen shake, switch to black and white mode, and even colour blocking, which highlights the most important aspects of a scene with 4 colour blind-friendly palettes to choose from.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41438465/2c9b4c3299a973992cc416b4cd58c6cb6c37beae.gif"][/img][/p][p]The Hyper Luminal Games team have built this accessibility toolkit which can now be imported into future projects, ensuring all of our games continue to be as accessible as possible.

Pine Hearts will be 25% off during the Access-Ability event.[/p][p][/p][p]If you’d like to chat more about Pine Hearts, you can join us over on [url="https://discord.com/invite/TYXxVxbvCC"]Discord,[/url] and if you’d like to follow Tyke’s Adventures, he now has a blog on [url="https://www.tumblr.com/pine-hearts"]Tumblr[/url]. We’d love to see you there.[/p][p][/p][p]Chat soon!
[/p][p]Melissa and Vicki[/p][p]Pine Hearts Community Team[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41438465/7422b829902cc37dd9d453df241eb7ad39201246.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 🎉Pine Hearts Turns 1🎉 Updates and Mobile Release Incoming, Plus New Publisher!
notes.content:
Hey Campers!

We can’t believe it’s been a year since we released our cosy narrative-adventure game set in a caravan park. As well as celebrating this momentous occasion, we also have lots of great news to share.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41438465/3c50a82ccf02c496c005f1504c97b04f38449d87.gif[/img]

[b]We’re delighted to announce that Pine Hearts has a new publisher![/b] We’ve found a new home with the award-winning team at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/SecretMode/]Secret Mode[/url], with the aim of bringing Pine Hearts to even more players. 

Not only will they be helping us with some in-game improvements and quality of life updates, such as side-quest tracking, but we’re also teaming up to bring Pine Hearts to mobile platforms later this year. We’ll have more details to share soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41438465/65bbf4de4d57f1daebbec8bc579e35dd9b7185a5.jpg[/img]

To celebrate this news and the anniversary of Pine Hearts, Community Managers Melissa and Vicki, of Hyper Luminal Games and Secret Mode respectively, have collaborated to bring you a new ‘let’s play’ video which you can watch now, either on our Steam store page or on YouTube:

[previewyoutube=2dkaXSIZH_E;full][/previewyoutube]

We’ve created a new Pine Hearts community channel over at the [url=https://discord.com/invite/TYXxVxbvCC]Secret Mode Discord[/url] server if you’d like to chat about the game, share your fan-art, and get the latest updates.

We look forward to bringing you more updates soon, so watch this space!

Melissa and Vicki
Pine Hearts Community Team

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Campers! 👋[/h2]

The warm summer weather has got us in the mood to go camping, so what better time for a patch update! The team have been working hard to fix some of the most common and impactful bugs the community has reported and I'm happy to update you on those fixes below. Enjoy the sunshine and we'll update you with more news from Pine Hearts soon! 🌲💚

- Melissa, Social Media and Community Coordinator

[h1]1.0.3 Update Patch Notes[/h1]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed a few instances where Tyke could get stuck walking in place trying to reach an object or NPC to interact with them.
[*] Improved visibility of an important quest item.
[*] Fixed an issue causing the Blue Knight’s helmet to appear invisible.
[*] Fixed an NPC being a little too generous with droplets.
[*] Reworded ‘Quit to Menu’ confirmation pop-up to be less concerning when it comes to save data! It will now let you know if your game will be saved or if you will be returned to a previous autosave if quitting while saving is not possible (such as in a Memory). Sorry about the frights!
[*] Fishing and Digging spots now accurately reflect whether or not you’ve already interacted with them after loading a save.
[*] The game now pauses if a controller is disconnected.
[*] Black and White Mode now remains active if it was enabled in a saved game.
[*] Fixed several issues with the Reset All confirmation pop-up appearing at the wrong time and activating other commands.
[*] Fixed an issue with some incorrect actions being described in the controller remapping menu. 
[*] Fixed Options Menu closing when backing out of a controller remapping confirmation.
[*] Fixed an issue that would lead to the Controls tab appearing in other tabs of the Options menu
[*] Fixed an issue that could lead to players having an empty Quest Log.
[*] Fixed a bunch of issues we made while trying to fix the above issues 😅 
[/list]

[h3]Quality of Life Bug Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added non-letterboxed support for 16:10 aspect ratios.
[*] Fixed Bonnie’s barks appearing misaligned on some resolutions.
[*] Fixed prompts for the Band not being fully visible on certain resolutions.
[*] Fixed Lost ‘n’ Found Achievement not triggering if the Ruined Castle was left too soon.
[*] The game can no longer be controlled if the game window is no longer active (i.e.: if switching to another window or if the Steam Overlay is open).
[*] The Mouse cursor is now automatically hidden when using a controller (until the mouse is moved).
[*] Fixed an issue that would prevent the Gameplay Data screen from displaying its status accurately.
[/list]

notes.title: Cozy new Metroidvania has Dark Souls design but a heart of gold
notes.content:

While both of those still involve a fair amount of peril, now, from indie developer Hyper Luminal and publisher Little Nook, comes Pine Hearts, a cozy new story-led adventure game that's just arrived on Steam.

notes.title: Accessibility Creators Visit The HLG Studio! 💚

[h2]Hey Campers! 🍃[/h2]

We recently organised a behind-the-scenes day for creators with various needs and understandings of the importance of accessibility options in games to have a hands-on experience with Pine Hearts! [/h3]

[url=https://safeinourworld.org/]Safe In Our World[/url] ambassadors [url=https://x.com/real_pengy]therealpengy[/url] and Phoebe Hesketh, and content creators [url=https://x.com/psykit]psykit[/url] and [url=https://x.com/MouseIsTaken]mousewastaken[/url], advocate for and are involved in supporting accessibility and mental health awareness in games. We wanted to give them a hands on opportunity to test our accessibility features and learn more about the game's story and themes and why building something inclusive was so important to us at Hyper Luminal Games.

They got to chat with members of the team including Creative Director [url=https://x.com/laffinglad]Rob Madden[/url], UX/UI Designer and Accessibility Lead [url=https://x.com/searraleishman]Searra Leishman[/url], and Social and Community Coordinator [url=https://x.com/f0xrocket]Melissa Cocker[/url] about all things Pine Hearts. As well as testing various accessibility settings and our accessibility hardware set up for events, we chatted about the origins of the game's stories and themes.

notes.title: Demo Fixes 🔨
notes.content:
[h2]Hello campers! ⛺[/h2]

[h3]We hope you've all been enjoying your visit to Pine Hearts this Next Fest 💚[/h3]

We're aware that a few folks have come across some bugs during their play through of the demo and wanted to give a quick fix guide to assist anyone else who might be experiencing similar issues.

[h3]🐶 Dog Pet Crash[/h3]

First up we have the crash some folks have encountered when trying to pet Bonnie at the start of the game. We think this might be a cuteness overload in the systems, so please reset the cuteness counter using these steps:

[olist]
[*] Open Windows File Explorer
[*] Copy command [b]%AppData%/../LocalLow[/b]
[*] Paste command into FIle Explorer
[*] Delete any folders that appear named 'Hyper Luminal Games'
[*] Relaunch the demo
[/olist]
We also have a handy video you can follow:
https://youtu.be/5sxzsnUDPh0?si=1x4JuyHVHd3uB22B

[h3]💻 Window Resizing[/h3]

We're aware of a few minor issues with the window scaling changes not being maintained after accepting selection, or windows automatically resizing after the menu is closed. We're currently looking at solutions for release but we recommend playing the demo in full screen mode where possible 💚

[h3]Any Other Issues? Let Us Know![/h3]

If your particular issue hasn't been covered in this post please feel free to leave a comment underneath describing your issue and we'll do our best to get the team on a fix 💪

We hope you enjoy the rest of your trip to Pine Hearts and will catch you again soon!

- The HLG Team
